name: Chronicle of the Chaotic Star Sea

pages.text: A structured compendium of the Chaotic Star Sea's geography and factions, not a line-by-line retelling of the source material.
pages.title: Chaotic Star Sea Compendium

pages.text: inner_sea: The Inner Star Sea is ruled directly by the Star Palace and guarded by the Twin Sages, who control teleportation arrays and Heaven-Mending Pill quotas.$(br)outer_sea: The island-dotted Outer Star Sea harbors pirates and rogue cultivators, with registration taxes and Anti-Star operations both in play.$(br)abyss: The Abyssal Rift holds high-tier sea beasts and smuggling routes, represented by the chaotic_sea_abyss_rift secret realm.$(br)void_palace_node: The Void Palace opens periodically, and its key fragments are prized by the Star Palace, Anti-Star Alliance, and Merchant Alliance alike.
pages.title: Geography

pages.text: $(l)Star Palace$() - The nominal authority of the Chaotic Star Sea, overseeing Outer Sea registration, island taxes, and campaigns against pirates and Anti-Star cells. With the Twin Sages in seclusion, the Elder Council and enforcers hold real power. Its loyalty route covers patrol merit, bounties, and Void Palace intelligence.$(br)$(l)Anti-Star Alliance$() - A coalition resisting Star Palace rule through coded recruitment, smuggled jade slips, and pirate support. Its covert route includes stealing keys and sabotaging patrols before converging on the Void Palace quest.$(br)$(l)Chaotic Star Sea Merchant Alliance$() - Neutral traders who move goods between both sides, using sailing and smuggling access to sell intelligence to either camp.$(br)$(l)Penglai Sect$() - A major sword sect specializing in water blades and escape arts. It is not bound to the Star Palace and offers Outer Sea hunts and secret-realm parties.$(br)$(l)Outer Sea Demon Palace$() - A demonic stronghold that sometimes cooperates with Anti-Star forces. Demonic cultivators may join, at the cost of orthodox reputation.
